submitted_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int AS year, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
validated_sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS INT) AS year, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 200
